description: This file defines the ConsumerIr class, which is an Android Activity demonstrating the usage of the ConsumerIrManager API. It includes methods to transmit IR patterns and retrieve available IR carrier frequency ranges, with UI interaction handling.

classes.name: ConsumerIr
classes.description: An Activity that demonstrates how to send IR signals and query IR capabilities using ConsumerIrManager.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and assigns event handlers for UI buttons.

methods.name: mSendClickListener
methods.description: Handles the send button click, transmits a predefined IR pattern if the IR emitter is available.

methods.name: mGetFreqsClickListener
methods.description: Handles the get frequencies button click, retrieves and displays available IR carrier frequency ranges.
